sloka: अमोघां तस्य शक्तिं च प्रददौ परमाद्भुताम् ।परेण तपसा लब्धां जघ्निवाँल्लक्ष्मणं यया ।। ७.१२.२१ ॥
transliteration: amoghāṁ tasya śaktiṁ ca pradadau paramādbhutām ।pareṇa tapasā labdhāṁ jaghnivām̐llakṣmaṇaṁ yayā ।। 7.12.21 ॥

translations.english: And he also gave him the supremely wonderful and unfailing spear, obtained through great penance, by which Lakshmana was struck.
